verdict.rationale: skills.sh's CLI covers all three distribution routes. Project-scoped installs are the default and are documented as "committed with your project, shared with team". `npx skills add` pulls from public or private GitHub, GitLab and Azure Repos using existing auth, with non-interactive CI-friendly flags. skills.sh also acts as a marketplace and leaderboard. Missing for 10: team-wide reproducibility via skills-lock.json restore is only experimental, version pinning is not evidenced, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of a team rollout.
